purpose: Fix the breadth requirement before R1/R2/R3 so field scope and precision are not redesigned after a focal pilot or outcome result.

current_secondary_evidence.role: metadata confrontation and transport triage only
current_secondary_evidence.reason: No current secondary system supplies the same frozen source-state, effective-community, functional bridge and reproductive endpoint contract required for a prospective P6 test.

nee_route_decision.required_form: at least one second prospective independent natural context using the same frozen H2/H5 mapping and outcome-state logic without retuning
nee_route_decision.independence_requirement: must be biologically and sampling-wise independent enough to constitute a prospective transport challenge rather than another block from the focal context
nee_route_decision.context_selection_deadline: outcome-blind during R1 after this rule is frozen and before focal confirmatory reproductive outcomes are opened
nee_route_decision.no_rescue_role: P6 does not rescue adverse H1-H5 results in the focal context and focal results do not authorize retuning P6.

route_ceiling.if_second_prospective_context_feasible: NEE Registered Report lane remains eligible, subject to H5/R3 feasibility and Stage-1 fit.
route_ceiling.if_second_prospective_context_not_feasib: Do not weaken H5 or relabel existing secondary metadata as P6; route the strong single-system prospective study to Ecology Letters, Ecology, or another appropriate general-ecology venue.
route_ceiling.if_H5_confirmatory_precision_infeasible_: Retain H1-H4 as confirmatory and H5 as descriptive/exploratory for the single-system study; reserve confirmatory H5 plus transport breadth for a later expanded NEE design.

forbidden: admit P6 because an external dataset happens to agree with the focal effect direction
select the second natural context after viewing focal reproductive outcomes
change visitor grouping, plant-state definition, endpoint family or aggregation rule to obtain transport agreement
weaken H5 after pilot investment merely to preserve an NEE label
treat current world/Izu metadata as a complete prospective transport contract
dependency_order: R1 focal and transport field-scope lock
claim_boundary: The second prospective context is a breadth criterion for the future NEE lane, not a missing Chapter 2 result and not evidence that any existing natural system already validates the synthetic mechanism.
